title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 9.9096e-3 eV²
  λ_q = 0.001017
  m_eff = 2.3346e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2070e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.1346 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0101 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.075360 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -1.217e+1
  J_spin = -1.894e-1
